svg.aria-label: Inside a router: packets arrive at input ports, where a longest-prefix-match lookup in the forwarding table picks the output port; the switching fabric moves them across; output ports queue and schedule them. The control plane (routing processor) builds the forwarding table.

svg.text: runs OSPF / BGP, builds the forwarding table
